headline: Florida Southern and Lynn beat the giant-killers
dek: Florida Southern beat Tampa and Lynn beat Rollins on Thursday, days after Tampa and Rollins had beaten the table's top two. The winners, third and fifth on the table with eighteen and fifteen points, meet on Sunday.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Florida Southern have outscored every other programme, but goals have not settled the table: Florida Tech lead it on a total from the middle of the pack.

wire.line: Tampa and Rollins, fresh from beating Embry-Riddle and Florida Tech, have both lost; Florida Southern and Lynn now meet.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic's home matches against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's home match against Trinity in September, have all passed their date with no result.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored eighteen of Palm Beach Atlantic's 30 goals this season, from 64 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Finlay Prain has scored seventeen of Rollins' 35 goals this season, from 77 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marcos da Silva has kept five clean sheets for Embry-Riddle.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rollins have conceded 36 goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

last_match.line: Lynn had beaten Rollins on this ground in September too; Rollins came in having beaten Florida Tech on Tuesday.

next_match.line: Florida Southern beat Lynn on this ground in September; both sides won on Tuesday and again on Thursday.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
